title: ReplicatesCommonsCommitment
description: Payload shape for a Mishpat::Commitment entry with action='replicates-commons'. The EPR provide-loop commitment: a peer commits to replicate a commons-reach EPR (content variant) or to offer hosting capacity to the commons (capacity variant). Source of truth: Holochain DHT (Mishpat zome, existing Commitment entry type — action discriminator distinguishes; no new entry type). oneOf union on `variant`. NOTE: the author does NOT supply `epr_scope`; the effective bounds.epr_scope is derived as [head_ref] at projection time (a content-scoped commons commitment is inherently scoped to its head_ref). Spec: genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-08-epr-acquisition-slice2b-provide-loop-design.md §4.

action.description: Action discriminator. Fixed at 'replicates-commons' for this commitment kind.

variant.description: Union discriminator. 'content' = pure provide of a specific commons EPR (head_ref); 'capacity' = hosting-capacity offer to the commons (commons_bytes + ratio_attestation).

oneOf.title: ContentVariant
oneOf.description: Pure provide of one commons EPR. The author supplies only rate_per_minute + reach_ceiling in bounds; the effective epr_scope is derived as [head_ref] at projection time (not author-supplied). The policy envelope fields provider/valid_from/valid_until are required: the storage projection (parse_replicates_commons) reads them fail-closed and bounds_validator check 3 needs the validity window.
